text:
Type: large geometric low-pile area rug
Use: anchoring a living or dining area; living room, dining room, home office
Style: modern, Scandinavian, contemporary
Materials: short dense cut pile, thin bound edge
Colors: black, off-white
Shape: large rectangle in a grid of squares split diagonally into black and white triangles, flat and soft, bold graphic contrast
Feel: graphic, bold, crisp, energetic
Goes with: white walls, black metal, light wood, grey textiles; modern, Scandinavian or industrial living rooms

product.name: SILLERUP
product.description: Durable, stain resistant and easy to care for since the rug is made of synthetic fibres.
